study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
cohort: Secundiparous women with a previous caesarean delivery (CS) who achieved a singleton, term, cephalic vaginal delivery from 2004 to 2014 at University of Southampton NHS Foundation Trusts
finding: Advanced maternal age, increased infant birth weight, and an urgent category of initial CS increase the risk of OASIS at VBAC, whereas MLE is protective.
